toegepas.voor: Afknou is iets wat jy doen en nie wie jy is nie
toegepas.na: Afknou is iets wat jy doen, nie wie jy is nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The contrast reads more naturally as 'X, nie Y nie' than joined with 'en nie'.
toegepas.fout: 'en nie wie jy is nie' joins a contrast stiffly; the idiomatic Afrikaans form is 'X, nie Y nie'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma contrast is what a fluent writer would write, and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A study-text sentence opening with 'En' is spoken style; 'ook' carries the link and keeps the qualifier 'party'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'En party' closes the list of reasons naturally, and 'Party besef ook nie' is a lateral move that also blurs whether these are the same children as before.

laat_vaar.voor: Hou aan en praat met die volgende grootmens as die eerste een nie luister nie.
laat_vaar.na: As die eerste grootmens nie luister nie, moet jy aanhou en met die volgende een praat.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Hou aan en praat' is a calque of 'keep going and talk'; putting the condition first and using 'aanhou' reads more naturally and keeps the persistence.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original instruction is clear Grade 6 Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral reordering of safety wording that also turns a direct instruction into 'moet'.

laat_vaar.voor: Dalk maak iemand jou self seer of knou jou af
laat_vaar.na: Dalk word jy self seergemaak of afgeknou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'iemand jou self seer' can read as the other person doing it 'self'; the passive puts 'self' clearly on the learner, which is the intended contrast with the learner's own bullying.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original reads correctly as 'you yourself', and the passive drops the explicit 'iemand' that makes clear a person is doing the hurting.

na_skrywer.blok: Maak reg met 'n grootmens se hulp
na_skrywer.voor: of en hoe hy wil hê jy moet jammer sê, soos met 'n briefie
na_skrywer.na: of hy wil hê jy moet jammer sê, en hoe, byvoorbeeld met 'n briefie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'of en hoe' is a clumsy stacked conjunction; splitting it and using 'byvoorbeeld' reads clearly at Grade 6 without changing the meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'of en hoe' stacks two conjunctions and makes a reader stumble.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this sentence is the consent step of the safety procedure (what the adult does first), so the writer owns its wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Childline is ekstra hulp en nie in plaas van hierdie grootmense nie
na_skrywer.na: Childline is ekstra hulp en kom nie in die plek van hierdie grootmense nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The second half has no verb; 'kom nie in die plek van' makes it a complete, natural clause.
na_skrywer.fout: The verbless 'en nie in plaas van hierdie grootmense nie' reads stiffly.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: It is the who-to-tell instruction in a safety block, so the writer should fix it, together with the identical sentence in 'As iemand jou seermaak'.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Childline is ekstra hulp en nie in plaas van die grootmense naby jou nie
na_skrywer.na: Childline is ekstra hulp en kom nie in die plek van die grootmense naby jou nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Same verbless second half as in the help block; keep the two sentences parallel.
na_skrywer.fout: The verbless 'en nie in plaas van die grootmense naby jou nie' reads stiffly.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Same safety who-to-tell sentence as change 4; the writer should fix both together so they stay parallel.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: dat jy dit amper sonder om te dink doen
na_skrywer.na: dat jy dit amper doen sonder om te dink
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Moving 'doen' before the 'sonder om te' phrase avoids the sentence ending on a second 'doen' and reads more smoothly; this does not undo the earlier round's 'sonder om te dink'.
na_skrywer.fout: The definition ends on a second 'doen' after the inserted phrase, which reads clumsily.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A genuine improvement, but it rewords a glossary definition beyond a grammar error, so it goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Hou op om saam te doen.
vlae.rede: Vague: it does not say with whom or in what; the reader must reach back to 'saamlag wanneer die groep dit doen' two blocks earlier. Making it explicit (e.g. joining in when a group bullies) would mean guessing the intended scope, so it is flagged rather than changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: 'n Rede maak dit nie reg nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: 'n Rede help jou om te verstaan
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'help jou om te verstaan' is the standard construction; the bare infinitive is colloquial.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'help jou verstaan' with a bare infinitive is accepted, natural Afrikaans, so the change is lateral and only more formal.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: as jy wil ophou om af te knou
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'ophou' takes 'om te' plus the infinitive; 'ophou afknou' is colloquial.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'ophou' with a bare infinitive (as in 'ophou rook') is standard and matches the lesson title 'Om op te hou afknou'; the proposal is longer and lateral.
